meta.name: genomic-intelligence
meta.description: Predicts regulatory features, gene structure, and expression directly from DNA sequence using Genomic Intelligence's hosted transformer DNA language models — no local GPU or model weights. Six tasks over a REST API and a hosted MCP server (keyless public demo): promoter regions, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression (log TPM), and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Use when the user has a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and wants any of these predictions, mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, api.genomicintelligence.ai, or mcp.genomicintelligence.ai.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA 序列,预测调控元件、基因结构与表达量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有 DNA 序列或基因组区域,想快速拿到调控与表达预测
copy.tagline_en: Predict regulatory elements, gene structure, and expression from a DNA sequence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a DNA sequence or gene region and want regulatory and expression predictions.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 可把基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列发给 Genomic Intelligence 的托管模型，取回启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、表达量等预测结果，全程无需本地 GPU 或模型权重。
howto.when: 当你手上有基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列，并想要上述某类预测时触发；提到 Genomic Intelligence 或相关域名也会触发。

say.text: 用 promoter 任务在这段序列上找启动子区域
say.note: 按滑动窗口给出启动子区间

say.text: 预测这段序列在 K562 细胞里的表达量(log TPM)
say.note: 需按 TSS 居中并提供细胞类型描述

say.text: 找出这个区域里的基因并预测各自表达量
say.note: 走 find-genes 加表达预测的复合流程

howto.what_en: Claude can send a gene symbol, genomic region, or DNA/FASTA sequence to Genomic Intelligence's hosted models and get back predictions like promoters, splice sites, enhancer activity, and expression (log TPM) — no local GPU or weights.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a gene symbol, genomic region, or DNA/FASTA sequence and want these predictions, or when Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, or api.genomicintelligence.ai is mentioned.

say_en.text: Find promoter regions in this sequence for me.
say_en.note: Runs the promoter task on your sequence.

say_en.text: Predict expression (log TPM) for this sequence in K562 cells.
say_en.note: Needs a TSS-centred 9,198 bp window and a cell-type description.

say_en.text: Find the genes in this region and predict each gene's expression.
